fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) has risen approximately 1,010% over 5 years on AI infrastructure demand, holding 18% of the high bandwidth memory (HBM) market and 21% of the DRAM market.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q4 2026 revenue of $54.2B (380% year-over-year increase) and non-GAAP net income per share of $33.42 (1,000% increase) demonstrate improved profitability.
fields.summary_ko.2: SK Hynix management indicated 50% of expected 2027-2028 production already sold and sustained demand through 2030, supporting Micron's long-term growth.
